theorems.name: Submission.cmc_ml_measure_eq_of_eq_on_open_subsets
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (O : Set (Euclid P)) (μ ν : Measure (Euclid P)), IsOpen O → (∀ C : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact C → C ⊆ O → μ C ≠ ∞) → (∀ G : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen G → G ⊆ O → μ G = ν G) → ∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → A ⊆ O → μ A = ν A
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
